notes.title: Small update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Just posting a small update to let you know I've fixed a handful of typos which were pointed out by people on the Steamworks forums and my Discord server.

The VN should be a little more polished now! As always, do let me know if you spot further typos or any grammatical errors in the story, and I will try to fix them in a timely manner!

- ebi x
